source_statement: Let ABCD be a rectangle and E be a point on segment AD. We are given that quadrilateral BCDE has an inscribed circle ω1 that is tangent to BE at T . If the incircle ω2 of ABE is also tangent to BE at T , then find the ratio of the radius of ω1 to the radius of ω2 .
